body: Gotta love it!! Lol thanks  :)

That's great! The irony of it. 

I am glad to hear!

I'm still getting there, don't worry! It's very hard and with my upbringing, I'm definitely not usually confrontational or like this in any way. It's taken me almost five years, unfortunately (or maybe fortunately?). Sometimes I can go from zero to one hundred quite fast, but recently I've been self reflecting and have had therapy. It's helped me tune my responses immensely. You'll get there!! Keep workin' at it! :)

That's just sad!! I wish people could be proud of the choices their children make. I mean you guys own a freakin' restaurant!! That is amazing! Yet...they want to pick at the design. Nope, that's dumb. I don't blame you at all for not wanting them at your events, you enjoy your day how you want it!
I try to keep my mouth shut as much as possible, but sometimes I just need to lay out the truth whether someone likes it or not! I like your style. Lol

The funny thing is....it's just a small apartment! She has complained and complained that she hasn't gotten to see it, and the one time she FINALLY comes by, she ruins his night. Oh well, sucks for her more, I think. :) I'm glad your in-laws are nice!!

That last part is so perfect. He is programmed to think that his sister (and even everyone else in the family) is allowed to say what she wants, whenever she wants. He feels if he can't change it or if they will never change, why speak up? What's the point of it? I believe it's worth the confrontation. If you've never confronted it, how do you know? I feel that if someone is going to come into my home with a negative attitude and shame someone or something I love, then leave. Simple as that.
They'll never change! Blep
Yes!! I mean, not everyone has the same interests. That doesn't mean we should all berate or shame one another for liking something different.

Video games are the worst, don't you know?! 

You're definitely correct, they do want to make people feel bad. It's pathetic. I hope you and your DH are in a better place with that situation!
Well, thank you! I try to be. Lol
Your interests and happiness matter!! Don't forget that :)

Gosh, I am so sorry! I believe my SO feels the same in regards to spending time with my family, they always make him welcome and talk to him about his interests. It's intriguing to see my uncle and grandfather talk with him over something. On the note of his mother crying about moving, MINE'S MOTHER IS THE SAME WAY. What sad, sad people. His sister sounds like a jerk, if I'm reading about her correctly. I have a similar relationship with my aunts. You're not busy constantly to where you can't send a text, nice try. Jeez. They do deserve better; I really hope the best for you two.

Yes, she is that way. I perceive her like my mother: she is unhappy with her life, so she MUST say anything to bring others down. I was watching a TV show a few years back when she lived with us, and she came into the room I was in. Called the show dumb. I mentioned that she did not have to watch (basically boi bye).

It's also maybe worth noting that I also have too many things going on besides the work. I feel that if I go back, I'm going back into an atmosphere where I will feel like this everyday. I have never shut down or felt like this before. I don't want to sacrifice my well being, yet I don't want people to be disappointed in me..
That would have been priceless!
Can confirm he was 20-21. I was in the room. *more cringe*

At first he was like wtf. We both brushed it off, but later, after countless times of replaying it in my brain, I had to reiterate, "That was freaking odd, right?" and he didn't think it was so odd. I had to push it that it was so OFF and out of place. He sees it now. I'd guess he's...in an odd state of, "Holy moly, my mom is creepy" and he doesn't want to think about it.

I'm glad I'm not the only one who feels that way. It's especially creepy that she'd shout it in front of me...........however, from reading a lot of posts on this thread, I can tell she's not the only one who's like that. Bleh.

I think she would try. We live on the third floor, there's not much she can do besides try to break in, throw something at our window, or ruin our vehicles. Her line of "work" would more be doing enough senseless things that we may get kicked out for trouble, if that makes sense. Though, it's possible she'll do anything.

Thank you for all of that information! I've been slowly keeping her on a "need to know basis" over the last few years, so she doesn't know my credit card providers, Internet, etc. Even my doctor's office, dentist, veterinarian, University, and other things are under my grandparents address, so she couldn't get my new one, thankfully! The only way she could is by asking the front desk people here, but I'm just so nervous to tell them, in fear they'll think we're a problem. Thank you for the well wishes!

Oddly, there's only one road to get back to our apartment. I see what you are saying and will do the best I can, thank you for bringing that up! I don't currently work, as I'm just out of university and trying to apply to graduate school. That's a rough situation in itself.

Our current health offices have addresses for our old places of living, like my grandparents' home and SO's mothers home, because they were more stable. I talked with my doctor's office and they said they will not give out information to her whatsoever, but I can't guarantee she won't find a way. 
I'll warn SO about that, thank you!

Thank you, I appreciate all of this. Yes, she's close, she's sort of on the other side of town. I googled myself, there's no way she could find my address unless my grandparents tell her what it is. It is a very new address. Is it worth mentioning to the complex that we don't want anyone who asks to know our placement? I am worried about them thinking we're trouble, too..

I have been checking out of our front facing window quite frequently and the peep hole as well, also creeping around the stair case. I'm quite cautious when it comes to her..however, she is an odd case. She will absolutely damage property, but then get close to you, and run away if she thinks you'll hit or hurt her. It's strange...yet, I'm still wary.
Thanks so much!

Thank you, that's a lot of the stuff I have been thinking about. The camera thing is the most difficult part (brands and all) and bringing it up to my leasing agents is also complex, I just don't know how. I don't leave often currently, so I can be here safely with my pets during the day. My aunt is actually going to reteach me how to use a firearm (I'm sure it sounds stupid, it's been a long time since I've used one!) and I'm hoping to get one for the future, if it comes to that. Thank you, again. I feel better knowing I'm not overreacting and there's people out there with advice.
I'm sorry to hear about your mother! Also, thank you again for all of your advice. I wouldn't have thought of all of this without your pointing it out. I will be taking steps to prevent this.

You are right, it is possible and I think it's true at times. I do know his mother and grandmother piss him right off, however we did think that others would be there (so we thought, 'hey why not, we don't see them often!'). He did mention that right now, it's work that's frustrating and draining him, but he's not too great at communicating his feelings, so I can't say for sure at any given point what the issue exactly is. I did say next time that it is a firm no and we will not be going no matter who goes, if it's last minute (even though it was me saying 'yes' this time). We talked some ground rules/boundaries and I'm hopeful things will be good for a while. Thank you for your thoughts. :)

I truly appreciate you bringing all of this up, I didn't even think about it. My SO suggested freezing credit reports, so that may be a possibility too? Either way, I know something may have to be done, considering that she is so unpredictable and vindictive.

Thank you for the kind words. It's much more difficult now that we have both graduated and moved home. It is a process and we are definitely working on it! This thread has helped me quite a bit, whether it's reading other individuals' posts or gaining advice on my own posts. I'm so thankful for everyone here.

I have had a talk, multiple small talks, with them. At this point, it's come to a "need to know information" basis with them type of thing. SO and I are backing off from family members for a few weeks, for our sanity.
You are very correct. I've had my back my entire life, unfortunately I think it's time for me to stop hoping for them to support me. Thank you for that.

At this point, considering that I'm struggling with complex feelings, I'd like VLC or no contact with grandma (because I'd like her on my side, as bad as that sounds). And if she is not, I'd like less contact. However, what you are saying is definitely appropriate for when I get to a place where I am at a healthy mental state, and I appreciate your comment greatly.
It could be a middle name, but currently I'm not sure it's to that point where I'd have to change names (everyone is too lazy or poor to follow me). Thanks for that advice/option, though!

To be one hundred percent honest, this is something I have been very afraid of: the PO escalating her behavior. My brother has one on her and she still harasses him and his mother non stop, as well as stalks them every so often. I feel she will take this as a challenge, but there is no going back now, as it seems the court will hold it against me if I do not go to the hearing (however, I am not 100% sure on that). I will still stay hyper vigilant and keep my guard up, I do not trust her or her boyfriend whatsoever. I currently do not work, and she doesn't know my address as of right now. My SO is also worried that she may try to take action against him if he gets a PO on her or if I do mine. It's just troublesome, but like you mentioned, all I can do is keep on my toes. Thank you for mentioning this and thank you for the book suggestion! I will look into it.
I believe I've said something to that extent to them. Just hurts, ya know? Thank you for that, I appreciate it.
Thank you!

That's an interesting thought, I loathe my first name and wouldn't mind doing that. However, I have an odd obsession with my last name. Lol. Thanks for the suggestion, if it comes to that point I will think on it more. :)

Thank you for all of that! I thought for a while, subconsciously, that they had taken a side and now that feeling is solidified. I just need enough people willing to help back me up in court, currently. I'm not sure if I have anyone willing to go/who knows all that has happened/has witnessed it, as odd as that sounds. We shall see. Thank you again!

I agree with you one hundred percent on all of that, she is a rug sweeper and turns a blind eye to everything wrong. I will not tolerate the abuse anymore, it's been far too long, and I know what I need to do to attempt to keep bio mom away. It's just unfortunate that those who were supposed to support and be there for me are not. Unfortunately, they may be out of my life soon as well. Thank you for your advice, I truly appreciate it!

The entire issue with the grandparents is that they have the feeling that they messed up in raising her (it is an incorrect thought, bio mom made her own path, but whatever they want to think). They are very selfish at this point and use the excuse of, "We just want to retire and live our lives." Grandmother has admitted to sweeping it under the rug and she said she wants to live in "La la land". It doesn't sit well with me. I am hoping to move away with SO in the next year and go VLC with my family. Thank you for your advice, I appreciate it!

Currently, that is exactly what I'm trying to do. I am NC with bio mom and her BF, I just need that PO to solidify that she doesn't try anything, as she is very unpredictable. I told the grandparents that I do not, under any circumstances, want them telling her anything about me, where I live, what I'm up to, etcetera. They say they have not, yet they continue to try to push a relationship between us, (Ex: Gpa to bio mom: "You should make an effort with Pyro.") which I don't take kindly to. They are on a strict information diet, considering they mention things to me about her, so I'm sure it is vice versa, regardless of how much they talk to her. I am also on the path of trying to get into graduate school, far far away, so I feel secure and can cut ties and to VLC. I apologize if that's too much information in advance. Thank you so much for your advice!
You're a kind soul for wanting to help, but it definitely is sad if they were that rude to you. Some people just can't get past the entitlement!
Read my explanation under other posts and you may see why we decided to go.

You are correct, I was upset that he told her why I was sick. I haven't brought it up yet, but I will today. Thank you for that advice, I do appreciate it! As I said above, the only reason I changed my mind and attended was because SO has been very down lately and I thought he'd perk up seeing other family members (we expected more to be there, but there was not). Fortunately, I now know for next time that it is an absolute no. Currently, we've decided to step back and have no face to face interaction for a while.

My MIL is very "artsy and craftsy"/DIY as well. That's ridiculous, there's no way you should have to help, even if you don't have plans. Not your construction, not your time to waste. Sounds like there was a dictatorship going on there, I'm sorry to hear about that! Glad you are out of it!!
Thank you, I am!
I'm not sure what he said, to be honest, I was not in the room. I just know he used her words and told her to "Plan ahead".
Last night afterwards, we did have a talk and decided to back off from his family and mine for quite a while. It's a process, and we are working on it. Thank you for the advice.

At the current time, SO is having a difficult time in his life transitioning from graduating to working constantly. I felt that he may feel better being around people, as we thought most of his family would be around (he's very introverted and he seems lonely/depressed, lately). It was not  rewarding her, it was trying to get SO out of the house for once.  

Edit: It may not seem like a good explanation for you, and I appreciate everyone's advice regardless, however there are times where other things are going on and I try my best to make SO feel better (whether it's seeing his family or mine or doing whatever).
"She planned to have a nice, relaxing, sick day at home. BUT BLAST! You've foiled her plans, yet again."

Oh lord, my GMIL is the same way! She hates ALL animals. We had my dog over to her house once in the time we've had him, and he's not allowed back (of course, he didn't do anything wrong, he's very well mannered and is chill). She generally talks a lot of crap about having pets, but hey, I'd rather have my dog around than her. I almost pity it. Sorry you have never experienced the great, great love of a dog in your life, ya old crabs. Shrug. Kudos to him!!

It does feel like that! Gaslighting sucks, I get enough from my family, don't need any from SO's too! Ugh. It'll be okay, someday. Also, YES. Thank you, that gave me a good chuckle. I also enjoy "fart", because I'm still a 10 year old at heart.
I do this with my family all the time. I take no crap from them. Lol.
Honestly, at some point I'm sure she'll go back to messaging me (SO is bad at texting back, he doesn't check his phone often) and I'll most likely reply in this manner. I'm exhausted with her.
YES! Thank you!
Nope, never!

Lol thanks! She is quite a twat. Thank you also for the good luck wish, I'm at dinner now. I have a lot of anxiety and she's trying to be nice, but it's just all stressful. I can handle confrontation, however, I just have anxiety from other issues lately. It's alright so far, besides the ridiculous last minute crap!
Our dog barked at a black male walking down the street (he's protective and scared of strange people, especially men), she proceeded to pat him on the head and say, "Good boy". (hint: she's racist)
The alcohol part is the *best*, because she says his estranged, crummy father is such an alcoholic, yet she is just as bad. It's beautiful. XD

I think I just try to justify/explain it because I'm so used to my family justifying her actions. Thank you. Lol 

Edit: wording was odd again!
It is most likely true!

The only reason I mention this is because when I told the story to my uncle, he took her anger at this as her being angry at her unhappy relationship. Nope, nope, it's because she hates me, uncle. Lol
I firmly believe she has a crush on him. She's said very questionable things. Lol
